title: Fravor and Dietrich saw appendages on Underwood's FLIR tape
place_text: USS Nimitz area, off Southern California

tellings.quote: both commander uh Fraver and uh Lieutenant Commander Dietrich have stated that when they reviewed Underwood's tapes afterwards, they saw these little appendages, these protrusions.

plain: In 2004, off the coast of Southern California near the aircraft carrier USS Nimitz, Navy pilots reported meeting a strange flying object, and a pilot named Chad Underwood filmed it with his jet's infrared camera (FLIR, short for forward-looking infrared). A man named Merrick, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that two other pilots from that day, Commander David Fravor and Lieutenant Commander Alex Dietrich, have stated that when they watched Underwood's footage afterwards they saw little appendages, small bits sticking out of the object. If true, the object had a shape and features you cannot easily make out in the footage most people have seen.
